text: 金房能源公告，公司控股股东、实际控制人杨建勋及其一致行动人魏澄、付英、丁琦此前于2026年1月4日分别与富强资产、能敬资本签署《股份转让协议》，杨建勋拟向富强资产转让825.7万股（占公司总股本的5.27%），魏澄、付英、丁琦拟向能敬资本转让合计814.57万股（占公司总股本的5.19%）。截至公告披露日，上述拟协议转让的股份尚未办理过户登记手续，且深圳证券交易所出具的《上市公司股份协议转让确认书》已过有效期，故终止本次协议转让事项。
text_en: Jinfang Energy announced that the company's controlling shareholder and actual controller Yang Jianxun and his concert parties Wei Cheng, Fu Ying and Ding Qi previously signed Share Transfer Agreements on January 4, 2026 with Fuqiang Assets and Nengjing Capital respectively. Yang Jianxun planned to transfer 8,257,000 shares (5.27% of the company's total share capital) to Fuqiang Assets, and Wei Cheng, Fu Ying and Ding Qi planned to transfer a total of 8,145,700 shares (5.19% of the company's total share capital) to Nengjing Capital. As of the announcement date, the above shares proposed for agreement transfer have not yet completed transfer registration procedures, and the Confirmation Letter for Agreement Transfer of Shares of Listed Companies issued by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has expired, so this agreement transfer is terminated.
